name: Rent an Owner
source:
Rent an Owner is a service for those who wish to be treated like a pet. You can hire a gentle owner to take care of you and shower you with affection without romance involved. Do you want to try being pampered for a day?

[from [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/rent-an-owner]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
出租主人是一项为那些希望被当作宠物对待的人的服务。你可以雇一个温柔的主人来照顾你，给你充满爱意，但不涉及浪漫。你想尝试被宠爱一天吗？

[来自[url=https://chanimk.itch.io/rent-an-owner]itch.io[/url]]
